enquiry.title: Start a project
enquiry.subtitle: Tell us what you are trying to build, modernize, automate or fix. A useful enquiry starts with the pressure on the system and the decision you need to make.
enquiry.body: The form collects the minimum information needed to respond thoughtfully. Nothing is shared outside SDK Enterprises, and you can also reach us directly at hello@sdk.enterprises.
enquiry.body2: Your technical and commercial context stays together while SDK assesses whether the work is a fit.
heroSignals: A finished specification is not required
Technical and commercial context stays together
enquiry.reasonsHeading: Bring the pressure on the system, not a polished procurement document.
enquiry.reasonsIntro: The form is designed to establish whether SDK can make the next technical decision easier.

reasons.title: A system needs to change
reasons.copy: Modernization, migration or integration work is blocked by uncertainty in the current state.

reasons.title: A platform is under pressure
reasons.copy: Reliability, delivery speed, infrastructure or data behavior has become a business constraint.

reasons.title: An AI workflow needs engineering controls
reasons.copy: The use case is promising, but data, evaluation, review or operation is not yet defined.

reasons.title: A workstream needs the right specialists
reasons.copy: The outcome is clear, but the project crosses disciplines the current team cannot cover alone.

enquiry.formHeading: Give us enough information to respond usefully.
enquiry.formIntro: Explain what is happening, why it matters and what has already been tried. Unknown budget, timing or technical details can remain marked as such.
enquiry.nextStepsBody: After you submit the form, we read it ourselves. If it is a fit, we will reply with a short written assessment and a proposed engagement model. If it is not a fit, we will tell you why and suggest an alternative.
enquiry.nextStep1Body: We review the system, constraint and requested outcome against SDK's current capacity and relevant expertise.
enquiry.nextStep2Body: A short written response: what we think the problem is, whether it is a fit, and what the first move would be.
enquiry.nextStep3Body: A 30-minute call or an async exchange to clarify scope, constraints, and timeline. No pitch deck unless you want one.
enquiry.nextStep4Body: A written proposal with scope, fixed price or rate, timeline, and milestones. You sign, we start.

validation.descriptionTooShort: Description must be at least 50 characters
validation.contextTooLong: Supporting context must be under 4000 characters

success.title: Enquiry sent
success.body: Thanks — we'll review the project context and reply with the next useful question or an assessment of fit.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.body: We couldn't send your enquiry. Please try again or email us directly.
